source: Algorithm 2, Theorems 2.5 and 5.2, Appendix E; Lan 2016 Corollary 1
contract: Run the exact nested Gradient Sliding recurrence and closed-form equation (7) argmin, not proximal gradient.
Use a bounded-domain nonsmooth objective with an exact subgradient bound and a full mixed affine matrix.
Select first-hit resources from a formula-independent grid and count subgradients separately from B/B-transpose actions.
Compare to an independent linear-program oracle and require collapsed-inner-loop and zero-penalty controls to miss.
